name: InputOTP
purpose: A field for a short one time code sent by text or email. Each character gets its own slot, and the whole code is one input underneath.

notFor.when: The value is not a short code of fixed length.
The value is a secret the person chose, not a code they were sent.

basis.note: Behaviors come from the Notion UI SDK inventory (2026-11-21). The support tag on each one was checked against the source on the checked date. The Notion page gives no alternative component and lists one mistake; the others come from the source and the vois-fields paste rule.

anatomy.note: The one native input. Holds the code, the pattern and the length.
Lays out a run of slots.
Shows the character at its index. One per character.
Goes between groups when the code reads better in sections. Hidden from screen readers.

behaviors.text: Typing a character fills the next empty slot. When the code is full, typing replaces the selected slot.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: _changeListener slices the value to maxLength; the caret sits at the last filled slot when full

behaviors.text: Clicking a slot lets you edit that character.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: focus and select handlers place the selection on the clicked index

behaviors.text: Pasting a whole code fills every slot at once and strips separators such as spaces and hyphens.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: the library paste handler runs only with pasteTransformer (or on iOS) and inserts at the caret; vois-input-otp sets pasteTransformer to strip spaces and dashes and selects the field when the paste fills it
behaviors.note: Without the transformer a pasted '123-456' is rejected whole by the pattern. A whole code replaces what is there, a short paste is inserted at the caret, and a long one is cut to the length.

behaviors.text: Autofill from a browser or password manager can fill the whole code at once.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: autoComplete defaults to one-time-code and the change listener takes any value that passes the pattern

behaviors.text: Characters that do not match the pattern are rejected. Touch devices get a keyboard that suits the pattern.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: a value that fails the regexp is dropped (empty is allowed); inputMode defaults to numeric and the pattern attribute comes from the regexp source
behaviors.note: A letters pattern still opens the numeric keyboard unless you set inputMode. Pass the pattern and inputMode together.

behaviors.text: Undo and redo work with the usual shortcuts.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: one real input, so the browser keeps the undo stack

behaviors.text: An outside control can read, fill, clear or focus the input, and those writes go through the same filter as typing.
behaviors.note: Pass value and onChange, and a ref for focus. Writes made through value are not run through the pattern by the library, so filter them yourself.

behaviors.text: Arrow keys, Home and End move the selection between slots.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: the browser moves the caret in the one input and the selection handler maps it to a slot

behaviors.text: Backspace deletes the selected character.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: a native input edit goes through _changeListener

behaviors.text: The slots are a visual display only. The group adds no tab stops beyond the one input.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: one input inside a pointer events none wrapper; the slots are plain divs

behaviors.text: The active slot is marked only while the field is focused. An empty active slot shows a blinking caret.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: hasFakeCaret is true only for an active empty slot; the blink is not drawn by the library
behaviors.note: vois-input-otp draws the caret with a step keyframe that stops under reduced motion.

behaviors.text: The active slot shows the focus ring as an external ring that keeps its offset in the error state.
behaviors.note: The library gives isActive. The ring, its width and its offset come from the focus tokens. Read-only slots show no ring on the slot.

behaviors.text: The code length is set by maxLength and defaults to the number of slots you render.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: maxLength is required and sets the input's maxLength
behaviors.note: Render one slot per character. A mismatch leaves empty slots that can never fill.

behaviors.text: The completion event fires when the code becomes full by typing, pasting, autofill or an outside write. It does not fire again when a full code is replaced by another full code.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: onComplete fires only on the change from shorter than maxLength to exactly maxLength
behaviors.note: The inventory says changing a full code fires it again. It does not. Select all and paste a new code and no event fires; handle the change event if you need it.

behaviors.text: A partial code fails length validation. A required field blocks an empty submit. A form reset restores the default value.
behaviors.note: The library sets no minLength. Validate the length yourself and show the error through the field.

behaviors.text: An invalid code shows an error message tied to the field and marks it invalid. Editing a digit clears the error.
behaviors.note: The library has no error state. vois-input-otp reads aria-invalid for the slot look. Connect the message with aria-describedby and clear it in onChange.

behaviors.text: Disabled blocks focus, changes and submission. Read-only keeps the field focusable and in the form data but blocks changes.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: disabled passes to the input, which then cannot take focus; readOnly is not handled by the library
behaviors.note: vois-input-otp blocks typing and paste in read-only itself and draws a flat look with no edge.

behaviors.text: A screen reader meets one input that holds the whole code. The slots, groups and separators are hidden from it.
behaviors.evidence: input.tsx: one real input; the slot divs carry no role and the separator is aria-hidden in vois-input-otp

behaviors.text: The field is named by its label and offers itself for one-time-code autofill.
behaviors.note: The library adds autocomplete one-time-code but no name. Pass aria-label or connect a visible label with id.

behaviors.text: The field reports an error to assistive technology.
behaviors.note: The library sets no aria-invalid or aria-describedby. Pass both.

mistakes.text: Do not leave a slot without relative positioning. Keep position relative on each slot so its caret stays inside it.
Do not reject a pasted code because it has a space or a dash. Clean the value after it arrives.
mistakes.evidence: input.tsx: the regexp rejects the whole paste unless a pasteTransformer runs first
mistakes.note: This is the vois-fields paste rule (FIELD-PASTE).

mistakes.text: Do not leave the field without a name. Nothing warns you.
Do not rely on the completion event to submit a code that was replaced by another full code.
mistakes.evidence: input.tsx: onComplete fires only on the change to full
mistakes.note: Handle the change event when a replaced full code must submit again.
